newsitem.title: ESTONIA: All Estonian stocks stronger on high turnover.
newsitem.headline: All Estonian stocks stronger on high turnover.

text.p: Active local interest brought good gains to Hoiupank and Forekspank but no real news was seen as powering the market, dealers said.
Total volume on the official list was 99.2 million kroons, almost double Tuesday's trade, and the Tallinn stock exchange index firmed by 1.34 percent to 240.26.
"The interest seemed to be local as there was no foreign buying to give us the second highest turnover of the exchange," one dealer said.
Hoiupank saw a trade of 22.8 million kroons to close on 124.59 kroons, a leap of 6.50 kroons.
"The only news that could have been of interest was that possible Lithuanian merger but there is no other news now or expected in the short-term," one dealer said.
Hansapank was most traded with turnover of 22.9 million kroons of shares. The stock's price picked up 0.85 kroons to close on 240.25 kroons.
"Hansapank saw block trades early and then later today, but its gain was nothing compared to Hoiupank's," said one dealer.
Uhispank was 0.75 kroons higher to finish on 49.75 kroons with a turn over of 18.8 million kroons.
Forekspank also made strong gains with a rise of 6.95 kroons to 170.95 kroons after 15.6 million kroons of shares changed hands.
On the free market, trade was 10.6 million kroons.
Tallinna Kaubamaja was the most active stock with 2.4 million kroons of shares turned over to edge upwards by 0.75 kroons to 86.00 kroons.
